inputs.subject: Questions regarding recent lab results and blood pressure - [Your Name]
inputs.body:
Dear Dr. Ross,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to discuss my recent lab results and some changes in my health metrics that I would like your input on.

As a reminder of my current context: I am 60 years old and currently managing hypertension and sleep apnea. My medication regimen includes:
- Apixaban 5mg (twice daily)
- Metoprolol 25mg
- Gabapentin 300mg

I have noticed a recent rise in my blood pressure and wanted to ask if this warrants any immediate changes to my treatment plan or if we should schedule a follow-up appointment to discuss this further.

Additionally, my latest Vitamin D level came back at 72%, which is an increase from my previous level of 68%. My GP mentioned a possible adjustment might be needed regarding this. Could you please advise on whether I should make any changes based on this new level?

Thank you for your time and guidance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
